issues.summary: INTEGER_LITERAL absorbs `&` and `^` via INT_SUFFIX, mis-tokenizing `1&2` and `2^3`.
issues.fix: Reduced INT_SUFFIX to `%` only; deferred bare-decimal-Long literal `100&` per coverage matrix (no corpus witness). Added regression tests `IntegerOperator_OnePlusTwo`, `IntegerOperator_TwoCaretThree`, `IntegerConcat_OneAmpString`.

issues.summary: DATE_LITERAL outruns preprocessor heads when the line contains another `#` (e.g., `#Const X = "#"`).
issues.fix: Anchored DATE_LITERAL's first content character to `[0-9 \t\-]` so it cannot start with directive-head letters. Added regression test `PreprocessorDirective_HashConstWithStringContainingHash_IsHashConst`. Documented limitation: textual-month form `#January 1, 2024#` deferred until corpus witness.

issues.summary: Comments did not implement §3.3.3+§3.3.1 line-continuation-before-comment-recognition (`' comment _\nfoo` should commented out next line).
issues.fix: Added LINE_CONT_FRAGMENT and embedded it in LINE_COMMENT and REM_COMMENT bodies as the first alternative in the loop. Added regression test `Comment_TrailingUnderscoreContinuation_ExtendsAcrossPhysicalLines`.

issues.summary: REM_COMMENT required trailing whitespace, breaking bare REM at end-of-line or end-of-input.
issues.fix: Made REM body optional. Added regression tests `RemKeyword_AtBareEol_IsHiddenComment`, `RemKeyword_AtEof_IsHiddenComment`, plus sanity test `Identifier_RemediatePrefixed_IsIdentifierNotComment` to confirm longest-match still favors IDENTIFIER.

issues.summary: Type-decl suffixes emitted as separate tokens diverged from Hazard H-A02 (suffix-as-part-of-identifier).
issues.fix: Added TYPED_IDENTIFIER lexer rule capturing `[%&#@$]` suffixes (excluding `!` to preserve bang disambiguation). IDENTIFIER remains for bare names and bracketed `[Name]` forms. Updated tests: `TypeDeclSuffix_OnIdentifier_IsTypedIdentifierToken` (now expects TYPED_IDENTIFIER), `TypeDeclSuffix_AllUnambiguousSuffixes_AreTypedIdentifiers` (Theory covering `% & # @ $`), `Bang_AsBangOperator_NotSuffix` retained, `SingleSuffix_RateBang_TokenizesAsIdentifierThenBang` added, fixture-07 smoke test asserts TYPED_IDENTIFIER tokens for `sFilePath$`, `i&`, `sErr$`.
